related.title: OASIS TAXII 2.1：分頁游標、版本去重與持久水位
related.titleEn: OASIS TAXII 2.1: pagination cursors, version deduplication and durable watermarks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付version-arrivals.json、receiver-decisions.csv、selected-state.json及conflict-ledger.json；每個決策可追到物件鍵、來源與內容雜湊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver version-arrivals.json, receiver-decisions.csv, selected-state.json and conflict-ledger.json. Every decision must trace to object-version key, source and content hash, allowing an independent replay to verify convergence.
related.difference: 在本機回放TAXII風格分頁封套，分離伺服器next游標、接收進度與持久提交水位，只有完整落盤成功後才更新同步檢查點。
related.differenceEn: Replay local TAXII-style page envelopes, separating the server next cursor, receive progress and durable commit watermark. Advance synchronization checkpoints only after the corresponding page has been completely and successfully persisted.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: STIX 2.1定義物件版本與撤銷；本課衝突隔離為本地接收政策，並非用接收時間替代modified，也不以內容較長決定哪個版本可信。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 五個合成ID各有v1與v2，共10個不同版本；A到D先收v2再v1，E先v1再v2。每ID的v2是已知正確最新版，其中A的v2為撤銷。 按到達覆寫只讓E保持v2，最新版正確率1/5=20%；按版本選擇五個都保持v2，正確率5/5=100%，四個陳舊到達不應倒退狀態。

TAXII 2.1以分頁與篩選傳輸STIX內容；游標是服務端續取資訊，不應自行解碼猜測。用物件ID加版本識別去重，單ID不可吞掉新版本。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 第一頁40個版本鍵、第二頁35個，其中5個與第一頁重複；第三頁25個且都新。重試時額外重送第一頁40列。 唯一版本40+35−5+25=95；正常頁面100列，加重試共140列，重複45列，重複比例45/140=32.142857%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: STIX 2.1 defines object versioning and revocation. Conflict quarantine is an explicit local receiver policy; arrival time must not replace modified, and longer content is not evidence that a competing version is trustworthy. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Five synthetic IDs each have v1 and v2, totaling ten distinct versions. A through D arrive v2 then v1; E arrives v1 then v2. Each v2 is the known latest version, including revoked A-v2. Arrival-order replacement leaves only E at v2, giving latest-state correctness 1/5=20%. Version-aware selection retains v2 for all five, giving 5/5=100%; four stale arrivals must not regress state.

TAXII 2.1 transports STIX content using filtering and pagination. Treat continuation cursors as server-issued information rather than guessing their encoding. Deduplicate object-version identities, not IDs alone, so genuine updates survive. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Page one has forty version keys; page two has thirty-five including five already on page one. Page three has twenty-five new keys. A retry additionally replays all forty rows from page one. There are 40+35−5+25=95 unique versions. Normal pages contain 100 rows; the retry raises received rows to 140, of which forty-five are duplicates, giving 32.142857%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
